property.name: Northgate Residence
property.description: A four-block residential complex of 96 units, completed in 2014. Shared facilities are an outdoor pool, a central courtyard, an underground garage, and a gated main entrance. Day-to-day decisions are made by a three-person management committee elected by residents, and everything else happens in a group chat with 180 members.

assets.label: A Block Elevator
assets.notes: Traction elevator, eight stops, 630 kg. The oldest control board of the four; the manufacturer stopped supplying its door controller in 2023, so parts come from refurbishers.

assets.label: B Block Elevator
assets.notes: Identical hardware to A Block. Had its encoder replaced in December 2025.

assets.label: C Block Elevator
assets.notes: Machine room faces west and runs hot in summer. A ventilation fan was fitted in May 2025.

assets.label: D Block Elevator
assets.notes: Control panel was partially rebuilt in February 2026.

assets.label: Outdoor Pool and Filtration
assets.notes: Open May to September. Sand filter, single circulation pump. Heavy use on weekends.

assets.label: Central Courtyard
assets.notes: Lawn, six mature trees, drip irrigation installed 2019. The irrigation manifold has been repaired once.

assets.label: Front Entrance Beds
assets.notes: Seasonal planting twice a year. The first thing anyone sees from the street, which is why residents raise it often.

assets.label: Lobbies and Stairwells
assets.notes: Four lobbies, four stairwells. Cleaned three times a week under a standing arrangement; deep cleans are commissioned separately.

assets.label: Underground Garage Lighting
assets.notes: Two circuits, 48 fittings, converted to LED in 2021. Circuit two has tripped twice.

assets.label: Main Gate Barrier and Intercom
assets.notes: Barrier arm, plate reader, and four block intercom panels on one controller.

assets.label: Water Booster Pump Room
assets.notes: Two pumps in duty and standby. Upper floors lose pressure first when either fails.

assets.label: Waste Collection Area
assets.notes: Six bins in an enclosure by the service gate. Municipal collection, not a contracted vendor, which is why problems here are usually scheduling rather than repair.

assets.label: Fire Alarm Panel and Detectors
assets.notes: Addressable panel covering all four blocks. Inspection is a legal requirement and is never left to an agent's discretion.

assets.label: A Block Lobby HVAC Unit
assets.notes: Single split unit heating and cooling the A Block lobby. Deliberately has no approval policy configured, so a problem raised against it demonstrates that an unconfigured category escalates instead of assuming authority.
